headline: Arcnights slips outside ARC-2 gold as cutoff rises

sections.text: Arcnights fell from 15th to 17th on the ARC-2 public board, leaving the 15 gold places at an unchanged 48.75. The gold cutoff rose 0.28 in the past day to 49.03; Arcnights is now 0.28 short.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
